newsitem.title: GERMANY: POLL - Bundesbank seen leaving interest rates steady.
newsitem.headline: POLL - Bundesbank seen leaving interest rates steady.

text.p: Following are the results of a poll of 10 economists on the expected outcome of this week's Bundesbank council meeting. The poll was conducted on Tuesday.
1. Will the Bundesbank cut its leading interest rates this week?
Yes 0
No 10
2. Will there be a further cut in the discount and lombard rates later this year?
Yes 2
No 8
3. Will there be another fixed tender at 3.00 percent this Thursday?
Yes 10
No 0
Detailed results of the poll as follows:
Economist 1. 2. 3.
Werner Verbockett, Commerzbank No Yes Yes
Klaus Baader, DMG London No No Yes
Matthias Haffner, BZW, Frankfurt No No Yes
Klaus Friedrich, Dresdner Bank No No Yes
Ulrike Kastens, TCM, Duesseldorf No No Yes
Thomas Kull, Westde. Landesbank No No Yes
Ralf Kugelstadt, UBS, Frankfurt No No Yes
Gerhard Lyons, DKB International No Yes Yes
Hugh Roberts, Nat West Markets No No Yes
Gerhard Grebe, Bank Julius Baer No No Yes
